description: Bile salt hydrolase (choloylglycine hydrolase) | Hydrolyzes glycine- or taurine-conjugated bile acids to unconjugated bile acids
reference: Ridlon et al., 2006; Rimal et al., 2024

description: 7α-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase | Oxidizes 7α-hydroxy bile acids to 7-oxo intermediates; can participate in CDCA/UDCA interconversion
reference: Coleman et al., 1994; Ridlon et al., 2006

description: 7β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase | Reduces 7-oxo bile acids to 7β-hydroxy bile acids, including UDCA formation
reference: Lee et al., 2013

description: 3α-hydroxycholanate dehydrogenase (NAD+) | Interconverts 3α-hydroxy and 3-oxo bile acids
reference: Doden et al., 2021

description: 3α-hydroxycholanate dehydrogenase (NADP+) | Interconverts 3α-hydroxy and 3-oxo unconjugated bile acids
reference: Doden et al., 2021; Funabashi et al., 2020

description: 3β-hydroxycholanate 3-dehydrogenase (NAD+) | Interconverts 3β-hydroxy and 3-oxo bile acids; contributes to iso-bile-acid formation
reference: Doden et al., 2021

description: 3β-hydroxycholanate 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) | Interconverts 3β-hydroxy and 3-oxo bile acids; contributes to iso-bile-acid formation
reference: Doden et al., 2021

description: Bile acid–CoA ligase | Activates unconjugated primary bile acids as CoA thioesters
reference: Funabashi et al., 2020; Ridlon et al., 2010

description: 3α-hydroxy bile acid-CoA-ester 3-dehydrogenase | Oxidizes the C3 hydroxyl group of bile acid-CoA intermediates and participates in terminal reduction
reference: Funabashi et al., 2020

description: 3-oxocholoyl-CoA 4-desaturase / pathway oxidoreductase | Introduces a Δ4 double bond and participates in stereospecific pathway reductions
reference: Kang et al., 2008; Funabashi et al., 2020

description: Bile acid CoA-transferase | Transfers CoA between bile-acid intermediates and incoming bile acids
reference: Funabashi et al., 2020

description: Bile-acid 7α-dehydratase | Catalyzes the defining dehydration step that removes the 7α-hydroxyl group
reference: Funabashi et al., 2020; Kim et al., 2022

description: 7β-hydroxy-3-oxochol-24-oyl-CoA 4-desaturase | Reduces/oxidizes unsaturated CoA-linked pathway intermediates
reference: Kang et al., 2008; Funabashi et al., 2020

description: Bile acid 7β-dehydratase | KEGG-assigned 7β-dehydratase associated with secondary bile-acid transformations
reference: Ridlon et al., 2006; Wise and Cummings, 2023

description: 3-dehydro-bile acid Δ4,6-reductase | Performs sequential reductions of unsaturated bile-acid intermediates
reference: Funabashi et al., 2020; Lee et al., 2022

description: Proton-dependent bile acid transporter | Imports unconjugated bile acids for intracellular bai-pathway metabolism
reference: Mallonee and Hylemon, 1996

description: Bile acid 5α-reductase | Converts 3-oxo-Δ4 bile-acid intermediates toward 3-oxo-allo products
reference: Lee et al., 2022

description: Bile acid 5α-reductase isoform | Converts 3-oxo-Δ4 bile-acid intermediates toward allo-bile acids; also implicated in CDCA pathway efficiency
reference: Lee et al., 2022; Meibom et al., 2024

description: 12α-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase | Oxidizes 12α-hydroxy bile acids to 12-oxo bile acids
reference: Macdonald et al., 1979; Doden et al., 2018

description: 12β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase | Reduces 12-oxo bile acids to 12β-hydroxy products such as epiDCA
reference: Doden et al., 2021

description: Bile salt hydrolase with amine N-acyltransferase activity | Conjugates unconjugated bile acids with amino acids or amines to form microbial bile-acid amidates
reference: Rimal et al., 2024; Guzior et al., 2024
